scope: Source-only progression and requested hints for the six existing farm-friend activities.

requirements: Full-screen illustrated farm scenes; controls within the scene and compact touch targets at least44 CSS pixels.
Clear light intro text directly over the scene, no flat/translucent backing strips.
Genuine difficulty progression and an ordinary easier option.
After two genuine wrong attempts on the current step, offer a glowing hint. Requested highlight only; no answer, progress or charge. Reset on a correct step; cancellation is free.
Preserve game IDs, existing progress/records, saves, completed-round allowances and the shared completion/reward path.
Approved Jade/Hope, Rhys/Noah, Jay/Mike audio only, aligned with each step.
Before future public activation, compact phone/tablet visual review and full installed-app easy/advanced rounds, including misses/hints, plus all existing private/public release gates.

requirementSources.status: Existing source audit; no claim that these gaps were newly observed on a phone.

games.name: Meadow Memory Pairs
games.baselineGap: 3 pairs below level8 and4 thereafter; no requested two-mismatch hint.
games.hint: Highlight a still-hidden matching pair, or the mate of the currently open card. During home delivery, highlight one unhomed friend and its matching home.

games.name: What Changed in the Paddock?
games.baselineGap: Three friends with four return choices and no two-miss counter.
games.hint: Highlight the missing friend's return choice and the vacant position; never restore it.
games.audioConstraint: Keep exactly three visible friends because the approved Rhys look recording explicitly says three. Look again preserves the same missing friend and current-step misses.

games.name: Copy the Farmer's Pattern
games.baselineGap: Mostly two foods, with three only on the final train at level4+; no requested hint.
games.hint: Highlight only the next required food and next empty wagon; replay preserves current-step misses. Neighboring wagons cannot accept the answer.

games.name: Who Made That Sound?
games.baselineGap: Three doors; two misses automatically reveal a clue instead of offering the requested hint.
games.hint: Offer after two committed wrong door pulls, highlight only the correct picture door on request. No automatic picture reveal in progressive mode.

games.name: Gentle Harvest Dash
games.baselineGap: Fixed three moving choices and six catches with no requested hint.
games.hint: Highlight the requested food and collection basket; delivery hint highlights basket and cart. Food motion remains bounded in separate lanes.

games.name: Build the Farm Picture
games.baselineGap: 4pieces then6 at level5; wrong placements have no requested hint.
games.hint: Highlight one unplaced piece and its matching slot; never place it. Keep nearest-slot acceptance for small screens.
games.layoutConstraint: Two rows preserve large piece targets on compact landscape screens; advanced tray has four columns. Existing twelve illustrated pictures and rotation remain.

common.selectedDifficulty: Session-only friendLevel; opening a new intro resets to the saved record. Ordinary shared completion preserves the highest saved record.

remainingBeforeAnyRelease: Actual browser/compact-phone/tablet visual acceptance, including maximum-stage hit targets and intro text.
Separately coordinated installed-phone full rounds for easy/advanced, hints/cancel/pause/audio, and saved progress retention.
Future release assembly: version/cache references, CI, private acceptance, public gate and ordinary public restart verification.
exclusions: No new monetization, rewards, save schema, accounts, updater or shared catalogue changes.
This is a reviewable source implementation; it does not certify AAA visual/native acceptance.
